confidence_basis: Consensus confirmed the paper identity; Springer metadata, public author-uploaded full text, and the already reviewed Canzoneri et al. (2012) dynamic-sound protocol lineage were checked. The 2013 article directly reports the PPS assessment apparatus, 3000 ms IN/OUT pink-noise sounds, forearm tactile site, 60/40 tactile/catch ratio, T1-T5 timings, voice-key response, 1000 ms pre/post sound silence, training/control contexts, and expected outcome. Exact original SoundForge files, acoustic transfer, electrical threshold/current, voice-key latency, and physical intervention execution remain caveats.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The audio-tactile PPS assessment can be recreated as the Canzoneri-family dynamic IN/OUT task. The 20-minute tool-use and pointing-control interventions are physical/context procedures rather than runner-controlled audio-tactile stimuli, so the parsimonious profile recreates the assessment block that is run before and after training.

source_checks.scope: Confirmed paper identity and abstract-level expected outcome: tool use extends PPS along the tool axis and changes body representation; pointing control does not.
Springer page checked for publication metadata, DOI, journal, date, and abstract.
Author-uploaded full text checked for Experiment 1A methods, tool-use training, results, Figure 3 caption, and Experiment 3 pointing-control text.
Used for the delegated dynamic-sound protocol details: T0/T6 baseline timings, 112 tactile-target rows, 76 auditory-only catches, two blocks, and C.I.R.O./SoundForge apparatus provenance.

review_attempts.result: Located the target Experimental Brain Research paper and confirmed the expected outcome at abstract level.

Recovered 3000 ms pink-noise IN/OUT sounds, near/far loudspeakers separated by about 100 cm, right-forearm tactile target, voice-key response, 1000 ms pre/post silence, 60% tactile targets, 40% auditory-only catches, and T1-T5 timings.

Canzoneri et al. (2012) supplies the runnable count/block/baseline contract matching the 2013 paper's 60/40 target/catch ratio: 112 tactile-target rows, including 80 audio-tactile rows and 32 T0/T6 tactile-only baselines, plus 76 catches split into two blocks.
Figure/result text reports a post-tool-use PPS central-point shift toward far space and Experiment 3 reports no comparable shift after pointing control.

stimulus_type.source_file: public full text / Springer DOI route
stimulus_type.evidence_note: The 2013 paper directly reports pink noise and 3000 ms duration.

source_provenance.value: Dynamic sounds follow Canzoneri et al. (2012), where SoundForge 4.5 shaped two pink-noise samples; original source files are not supplied.
source_provenance.evidence_note: The 2013 method says procedures were similar to Canzoneri et al. (2012).

trajectory_count.value: Two auditory trajectories: IN/approaching and OUT/receding.
trajectory_count.evidence_note: The paper describes IN and OUT sounds.

trajectory_path.value: Near loudspeaker on the table near the forearm; far loudspeaker on the floor about 100 cm from the near loudspeaker.
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Participant was blindfolded with right arm prone on a table beside them.

stimulus_duration.value: 3000 ms sound, preceded and followed by 1000 ms silence.
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: The silence windows define the trial timing around the active sound.

stimulus_speed.value: Approximate apparent path of 100 cm over 3000 ms, about 0.33 m/s.
stimulus_speed.source_file: public full text plus protocol lineage
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: The original apparent motion is intensity/gain based; speed is a toolkit reconstruction convenience.

auditory_conditions.evidence_note: Both directions are analysed through D1-D5 perceived distance mapping.

gain_envelope.value: Canzoneri 2012 reports mirrored exponential intensity manipulation; exact SoundForge envelope files are unavailable.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: Enough endpoint/gain-direction information exists for a toolkit proxy, not bit-identical author audio.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two physical loudspeakers; toolkit recreates as a binaural virtual trajectory with apparatus provenance.
renderer_or_apparatus.source_file: public full text plus Canzoneri 2012 lineage
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: Exact loudspeaker model and room transfer are not reported.

trial_rows_families.value: Audio-tactile target rows, T0/T6 tactile-only baseline rows, and auditory-only catch rows.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The 2013 paper directly reports T1-T5 targets and catches; T0/T6 baselines are inherited from the delegated 2012 protocol.

condition_intermixing.value: Sound condition, tactile timing, and catches randomly combined/intermingled.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: Exact randomization seed/order is not reported and remains a toolkit default.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Assessment trials split into two paper blocks.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: The 2013 design places the assessment before/after physical tool-use; the runnable profile recreates one assessment.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Fixed 1000 ms silence before and after the sound; no separate variable ITI or hazard function reported.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: Toolkit uses source-timing metadata plus its default block spacing for unattended gaps.

response_window.source_file: public full text; Canzoneri 2012 manual review
response_window.evidence_note: Vocal response/voice relay are reported, but no explicit timeout was found.

task_sequence_rules.value: Participants respond vocally to tactile targets as soon as possible while trying to ignore the auditory stimulus.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: The runner emulates this with mouse-click response proxies to tactile rows and withheld clicks on catches.

tactile_stimulus.value: Tactile stimulus on the hairy surface of the right forearm.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Electrical hardware/current calibration is inherited as apparatus provenance from the Canzoneri family but participant thresholds remain individual.

soa_table.value: T1 300 ms, T2 800 ms, T3 1500 ms, T4 2200 ms, T5 2700 ms after sound onset.
soa_table.evidence_note: The paper also gives trial-start equivalents after 1000 ms pre-sound silence.

baseline_strategy.value: Tactile-only T0/T6 baselines during silence, inherited from Canzoneri et al. (2012).
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: The 2013 paper does not restate T0/T6 in the short method paragraph but reports procedures similar to the 2012 protocol.

baseline_timing.value: T0 at 300 ms from trial start (-700 ms relative to sound onset); T6 at 4600 ms from trial start (3600 ms after sound onset).
baseline_timing.evidence_note: These timing anchors produce 32 tactile-only baseline rows per assessment.

catch_trial_type.value: Auditory-only catch trials with no tactile stimulation.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: The 2013 paper reports the remaining 40% of trials were catches.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Eight target trials for each T0-T6 timing for each IN/OUT direction.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: For the audio-tactile PPS rows this yields 80 T1-T5 target rows per assessment.

baseline_count.value: 32 tactile-only T0/T6 baseline rows per assessment.
baseline_count.evidence_note: 2 baseline timings x 2 IN/OUT trial contexts x 8 repetitions.

catch_count.evidence_note: This matches the 2013 paper's 40% catch description when paired with 112 tactile-target rows.

block_count.evidence_note: The profile uses two balanced runner blocks for one pre/post assessment instance.

total_trial_count.value: 188 runnable rows per assessment: 80 audio-tactile targets, 32 tactile-only baselines, and 76 catches.
total_trial_count.source_file: public full text plus Canzoneri 2012 lineage
total_trial_count.evidence_note: The profile can be run before and after physical tool-use to reproduce the paper's assessment schedule.

expected_scientific_outcome.primary_expected_effect: Tool-use shifts the fitted PPS boundary toward farther auditory locations and changes forearm body-representation metrics; pointing control does not produce the same PPS/BR shift.
expected_scientific_outcome.observable_metric: tactile RT by D1-D5 perceived auditory distance, sigmoidal central point, tactile-distance P-Forearm, and body-landmark localization
expected_scientific_outcome.condition_contrast: pre versus post 20-minute tool-use training, with pointing-control comparison in Experiment 3

orientation_ledger.participant_frame: Blindfolded seated participant, right arm prone on a table beside the body during PPS task.
orientation_ledger.room_apparatus_frame: Near loudspeaker on the table near the forearm; far loudspeaker on the floor about 100 cm from the near loudspeaker.
orientation_ledger.body_relative_mapping: IN sound is perceived as approaching toward the forearm/body; OUT sound is perceived as receding away from the forearm/body.
orientation_ledger.tactile_anchor: Hairy surface of the right forearm.

visual_forms.form: RT by perceived sound distance with fitted sigmoidal functions
visual_forms.x_axis: D1 farthest to D5 closest perceived sound distance
visual_forms.metric: sigmoid central point / PPS boundary proxy
visual_forms.verification_note: Caption reports central point shift after tool-use relative to before tool-use.

visual_forms.form: RT by perceived sound distance with fitted sigmoidal functions for pointing control
visual_forms.x_axis: D1 farthest to D5 closest perceived sound distance
visual_forms.metric: sigmoid central point / PPS boundary proxy
visual_forms.verification_note: Caption reports no comparable central-point shift after pointing.

critical_caveats: Exact original SoundForge pink-noise samples and gain/envelope files are not available.
Exact loudspeaker model, room transfer, and physical SPL calibration route are not fully reported.
Participant-level tactile threshold/current calibration and detailed stimulator waveform are not sufficient for physical equivalence.
Voice-key response threshold and latency correction are not reported.
The toolkit profile recreates the audio-tactile PPS assessment; the 20-minute tool-use and pointing-control interventions remain physical/context procedures.
next_manual_action: Run the paper-specific profile validator and update generated profile/coverage ledgers from the known-parameter profile.
